text: Construction to Connection We are Meet the teamThe Reality Eindhoven Faces KnoopXL: Major Transformation in the next 20-25 years. Continuous Construction Long-term disruption in Fellenoord Highway zone The Problem Knoop XL Redevelopment Phasing Plans A key connection disappears • Kruisstraat tunnel closing • ±5,000 pedestrians / ±10,000 cyclists daily • Direct link between north and city centre lost Impact: • Longer routes • Unsafe mixing with traffic • Reduced accessibility The Bigger Impact • It’s not just mobility — it’s city life • 372+ small businesses affected • Residents lose daily convenience • Area becomes less attractive • People will live in construction for years not just weeks Stakeholders Our vision Don’t just reroute people, keep them connected Transform this opportunity into something people will miss when it’s gone.
